api_warning: pre-computed missions are based on an outdated orbit solution
notes: Pre-computed ballistic trajectories from Earth to Bennu (JPL). The API warns they use an outdated orbit solution.
c3_km2_s2 = vinf_dep squared (launch energy). Higher C3 means the launch vehicle can carry less mass.
arrival_braking_dv_km_s = vinf_arr: speed to cancel to stay with Bennu (Bennu's gravity is negligible), use it in the rocket equation.
comm_delay_at_arrival_min = Earth distance at arrival / speed of light (one way).
is_future = launch date on or after 2026-11-14.
braking_propellant_per_kg_dry = propellant mass needed per 1 kg of dry spacecraft to cancel the arrival speed, rocket equation with Isp 230 s.

brakable_like_osiris_rex = arrival braking <= 1.97 km/s. 1.97 km/s is an estimate of OSIRIS-REx total delta-v capacity (Isp 230 s, 2,110 kg wet, 880 kg dry). Options above it cannot stop at Bennu with a similar propellant load.
